title: Progress of Efforts to Uplift Private Security Industry
what_it_is: Progress of Efforts to Uplift Private Security Industry

sections.label: Security Industry Transformation Map launch
sections.summary: The Security Industry Transformation Map was launched in February 2018 to uplift the industry.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: To uplift the industry, the Security Industry Transformation Map (ITM) was launched in February 2018.

sections.label: Government outcome-based security contracts
sections.summary: Government agencies will progressively adopt outcome-based security contracts from the middle of this year, with Government contracts worth over $350 million yearly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Government will take the lead, with all Government agencies adopting outcome-based security contracts progressively from the middle of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This is significant, as Government contracts amount to over $350 million per year, which is about one-fifth of industry demand.

sections.label: Overtime exemption removal and PWM wages
sections.summary: The security industry's overtime exemption will be removed from January 2021, and PWM wages will increase by at least 3% per year till 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The exemption given to the security industry, which allows them to exceed the Ministry of Manpower's statutory limit on overtime, will be removed from January 2021, so that officers will no longer work excessive hours.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: PWM wages will increase by at least 3% per year till 2024.

sections.label: Security officers working 90 hours
sections.summary: On the first question, removing the overtime exemption, some security officers could potentially work 90 hours a week.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the first question, the removal of the overtime exemption, currently there are security officers who could be potentially working 90 hours a week.

sections.label: Minimum base wage increase to 2024
sections.summary: Many security officers will see their minimum base wage increase by approximately a minimum of 3% per year to 2024.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Many of the security officers will see their minimum base wage increase by approximately a minimum of 3% per year all the way to 2024.

sections.label: Old regulations warning or revocation options
sections.summary: Previously under the old regulations, authorities had only two options: give a warning or revoke or suspend the security officer.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Because, previously, under the old set of regulations, the authorities really only had two options: either to give a warning or to basically revoke or suspend the security officer.

sections.label: Security officers shift hours
sections.summary: The Security Industry Transformation Committee encourages security agencies to move towards shorter working hours where possible.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: With regard to the Member's first question on the movement towards shift hours, definitely the Security Industry Transformation Committee, which has been very instrumental in looking at the Security Industry Transformation Map, wants to have better working conditions for our security officers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, definitely, where possible, and the security agencies are able to adjust their working hours, they would encourage the security agencies to move towards shorter working hours.
